Job Description:
Are you structured, curious, and passionate about intuitive user experiences? At Intralox, one of the world’s leading innovators in conveyance solutions, we are looking for an Automation Engineer (HMI & UX) to join our Controls Product Engineering Team and play a key role in improving the usability, consistency, and quality of our customer-facing automation software solutions.

Why this role matters 

You’ll join the Integration Smart Carryway™ (ISC) team, a subset of Controls Product Engineering. This team supports automation platforms that are expanding beyond our Activated Roller Belt™ (ARB™) equipment into areas such as spirals and water systems, with close collaboration between colleagues in Europe and the US. What makes this team different is the combination of automation engineering, software quality, and operator-facing design, all aimed at creating solutions that are not only reliable, but also intuitive and easy to use. Collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement are at the heart of how we work.

As an Automation Engineer (HMI & UX), you’ll help shape how customers and operators interact with our equipment through clear, consistent, and user-friendly HMI solutions. You’ll improve the usability of operator-facing interfaces while also strengthening QA/QC practices, release readiness, and software lifecycle ownership. This is a great opportunity to build a growing capability and have visible impact on how Intralox automation solutions are experienced across platforms and regions.

What You’ll Do

Develop and harmonize HMI standards, screen layouts, navigation structures, dashboards, and reusable templates to create a more intuitive and consistent user experience across equipment projects 
Improve the usability and clarity of operator-facing interfaces to help customers and operators interact with equipment more effectively, with less training and less ambiguity 
Test and validate automation software releases to ensure customer-facing updates improve functionality without negatively affecting existing systems 
Build scalable QA/QC methods, documentation, and release-readiness processes to support reliable, repeatable, and high-quality software delivery 
Support lifecycle ownership of software updates, feature releases, supplier changes, and obsolescence topics to help maintain sustainable and customer-relevant automation platforms over time 
Work closely with automation engineers and cross-functional stakeholders in Europe and the US to solve issues structurally and support greater global platform consistency 
Support code development in different software environments to contribute to stronger engineering practices and more robust automation deliverables across the organization 

What You Bring

A bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, Automation/Controls Engineering, or a related field 
0–2 years of experience, or relevant exposure through internships, co-ops, coursework, or hands-on projects; candidates with more experience are also welcome 
Familiarity with software QA/QC, structured testing, validation, release readiness, or DevOps-style ways of working 
A foundational understanding of industrial automation systems and how HMIs are used to operate equipment 
Exposure to HMI/SCADA tools, operator interface design, or UX/UI principles 
Strong communication skills, learning agility, and the ability to work effectively in a self-managed, cross-functional team 
A valid passport and willingness to travel occasionally 

Nice-to-haves

Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, release workflows, version control, Git, or change management 
Familiarity with industrial HMI/SCADA and visualization tools such as Optix, CODESYS Visualization/WebVisu, Ignition, Siemens WinCC, WinCC Unified, TIA Portal HMI, Rockwell FactoryTalk View, or Node-RED 
Understanding of high-performance HMI principles, IEC 61131-3 programming concepts, industrial communication protocols, or data tools such as OPC UA, Modbus, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, MQTT, datalogging, historians, trending, reporting, or SQL-based tools 

If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about the role, we still encourage you to apply. 

Why Intralox? 

International environment with opportunities to grow your career globally. 
A supportive, high-performing team that values collaboration. 
A workplace driven by ideas, innovation, and ownership. 
A financially strong, market-leading brand. 
Performance-based profit sharing. 
25 holiday days + 6 ATV days. 
Excellent benefits package including a mobility card for business and personal use, pension scheme and contributions to health & life insurance.

Building great things together 

Intralox is a global leader in innovative conveyance solutions, with more than 3,000 employees across 20+ countries. For over 50 years, we’ve helped customers grow by solving complex challenges with smart, reliable solutions.

At our core is a simple principle: do the right thing. We’ve built a culture grounded in honesty, fairness, and respect, where every idea is valued, and great thinking can come from anywhere. Self-managed, curious individuals thrive here.

We believe great results start with great people. That’s why we bring together driven, collaborative teams who are passionate about making a real-world impact. You’ll be empowered to take initiative, supported in your growth, and encouraged to continuously improve, while working alongside colleagues who celebrate shared success.

Note: To be considered for this role, you need to be based in the Netherlands and have a valid work permit.
